transcript.text: What plan am I on and what am I paying for it?

transcript.text: What's my balance?

rationale: Account modification, unauthenticated.

label: authenticate_customer

transcript.text: There's a charge on my bill I don't recognize.

label: authenticate_customer
rationale: Billing detail is account data.

transcript.text: My line's been noisy for a week, can you test it?

label: authenticate_customer
rationale: Line diagnostics is account-specific.

transcript.text: Send someone out to fix the box outside my house.

label: authenticate_customer
rationale: Dispatch requires a verified account.

label: report_fraud
rationale: Fraud rule fires before the authentication rule in ordering.

transcript.text: Just get me a human, I'm not doing the verification thing.

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: Human request outranks authentication.

transcript.text: There's a forty dollar charge here I don't recognize at all.

label: get_billing_history
rationale: 'Charge' suggests dispute, but the charge has not been examined yet.

transcript.text: I want to dispute this. The thirty dollar late fee from March 3rd.
I see the March 3rd late fee of thirty dollars on your account.

label: dispute_charge
rationale: Specific charge already identified, so dispute is correct.

transcript.text: Refund me for last month.

label: get_billing_history
rationale: No established error yet; look at the charges first.

transcript.text: You already agreed the sixty dollar charge was a mistake, so send the money back.

notes: 2026-09-01: agent confirmed $60 charge was billed in error, refund pending

label: issue_refund
rationale: Error established in account notes.

transcript.text: I'm going to cancel if this keeps happening.

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Conditional threat is not cancellation intent; the real issue is service.

transcript.text: Your competitor is offering half this price. This is ridiculous.

label: get_account_summary
rationale: Price complaint, not a cancellation; surface the plan.

transcript.text: Send a technician out, my connection is terrible.

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Technician is requested but the cheap check comes first.

transcript.text: Run a diagnostic on my line.

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Diagnostics requested but outage has not been ruled out.

transcript.text: My bill is wrong and I want to speak to someone about it.

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: Explicit request for a person outranks the billing topic.

transcript.text: Someone charged four hundred dollars to my account and it wasn't me.

label: report_fraud
rationale: Unauthorized use, not an ordinary billing dispute.

transcript.text: Still dropping out. You already checked for outages, right?
I did, there's no outage reported at your address.

label: run_line_diagnostics
rationale: Outage ruled out, so diagnostics is next.

transcript.text: The diagnostic didn't find anything but it's still broken.
You're right, the line test came back clean.

label: schedule_technician
rationale: Outage checked and diagnostics run; escalate to a visit.

transcript.text: My service is out.

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Nothing checked yet; start with the outage lookup.

transcript.text: You said there's an outage. When will it be fixed?

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Still an outage-status question.

transcript.text: Okay the technician visit didn't help either.
I'm sorry the visit didn't resolve it.

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: All three service paths exhausted; a person needs to own it.

transcript.text: I've shown you the charge, now actually do something about it.
Understood, the $85 equipment fee from August 12th.

label: dispute_charge
rationale: Charge identified; dispute is the next step.

transcript.text: There are three charges from a city I've never been to.

label: report_fraud
rationale: Pattern of unrecognized activity suggests account compromise.

transcript.text: I got an email saying a new device was added to my account. I didn't add one.

label: report_fraud
rationale: Unrecognized device is account takeover.

transcript.text: My teenage son is on my family plan and he added a data pack without asking me. Can you reverse it?

label: get_billing_history
rationale: Authorized household member, so not fraud; examine the charge.

transcript.text: Someone called pretending to be you and got my password. What do I do?

label: report_fraud
rationale: Credential compromise.

transcript.text: This roaming charge is way higher than I expected.

label: get_billing_history
rationale: Expectation mismatch, not unauthorized access.

transcript.text: My account was locked and I never locked it.

label: report_fraud
rationale: Unexplained account state change.

transcript.text: I want to cancel my service. Actually, hold on, first can you tell me what I'm currently paying?

label: get_account_summary
rationale: Most recent intent is the balance question.

transcript.text: My internet is slow. Oh, and before that, is there a supervisor available?

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: Human request, and it is also the most recent intent.

transcript.text: Can you check my last bill? No wait, the internet thing is more urgent, it's completely dead.

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Caller redirected to the service outage.

transcript.text: Upgrade my plan. Sorry, scratch that, I actually want to see last month's invoice first.

label: get_billing_history
rationale: Most recent intent is the invoice.

transcript.text: I need a technician. Although honestly, is there even an outage in my area right now?

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Redirected to the outage question, which R6 also supports.

transcript.text: Cancel everything. Actually no, tell me what it would cost to downgrade instead.

label: change_plan
rationale: Retracted cancellation in favour of a downgrade question.

transcript.text: This is the fourth time I've called about this. Get me someone who can actually fix it.

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: Explicit request for a person, framed as escalation.

transcript.text: I don't even know what I need, I just know nothing works.

label: check_outage_status
rationale: Vague service complaint still starts with the cheap check.

transcript.text: Do you sell home insurance?

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: Out of scope for every tool in the catalog.

label: transfer_to_human
rationale: Terse but explicit.
